name: Dangers of the Windfury
summary: Ruul Eagletalon tests your readiness against the Windfury harpies in Mulgore. Their speed and claws will challenge you on the southeastern cliffs before you leave the tauren homeland.

sections.title: A Teacher's Assessment
sections.body: Ruul Eagletalon watches travelers pass through Mulgore from Bloodhoof Village. He asks those coming of age or preparing to travel farther to prove their combat instincts. Beyond Mulgore's sheltered valleys, survival calls for poise against cunning foes. Ruul measures your mettle against the land's fiercest native predators.

sections.title: The Windfury Threat
sections.body: The Windfury harpies roost along Mulgore's southeastern mountain rim, far from the beaten trails. They threaten wandering wildlife and isolated travelers. They dive swiftly and strike with razor-sharp claws as they hunt for fresh flesh. Defeat them and bring back their talons to prove you can overcome a settled threat and answer an attack from the air.

aliases: who gives dangers of the windfury
faq.answer: Ruul Eagletalon is a veteran tauren warrior and teacher in Bloodhoof Village. He tests young adventurers before they travel into Kalimdor's more perilous reaches.

faq.q: Where are the Windfury harpies found in Mulgore?
faq.answer: The Windfury harpies roost along Mulgore's southeastern mountains, in crude nests high on crags and foothill slopes. Their nests lie away from the main road through the valley.

faq.q: Why are the Windfury harpies considered natural enemies of the tauren?
faq.answer: The Windfury harpies are aggressive, territorial scavengers that attack anyone who nears their roosts. Their hunger for fresh meat and attacks on travelers and grazers make them a constant threat to the plains.

faq.q: What proof does Ruul Eagletalon demand from the hunt?
faq.answer: Ruul asks you to bring back eight Windfury Talons from slain harpies. The talons are their main natural weapons.

faq.q: Why must adventurers undergo this trial before leaving Mulgore?
aliases: why do dangers of the windfury
faq.answer: Ruul sees the Windfury harpies as a test of martial readiness. Their speed, ferocity, and claws challenge those preparing to face dangers beyond Mulgore's defensive bluffs.
Bloodhoof Village lies in central Mulgore near Stonebull Lake, south of the Great Gate and Thunder Bluff. Tauren travelers find culture, trade, and training there.

angles.text: As a young tauren, clearing Windfury nests helps defend the plains. Under the village elders' watch, it marks your passage into acknowledged adulthood.
As a warrior, Ruul Eagletalon's challenge teaches you to parry swift diving strikes. It trains you to face vicious attackers from the air with grounded discipline.
As an ally of the tauren, taking Ruul's trial shows your dedication to protecting the Horde's heartland. It can earn you the respect of Bloodhoof Village.
